canonicalContracts.integerLattice: Every emitted exact coordinate is an integer block cell; bounds are inclusive.
canonicalContracts.largeSetRule: Large exact sets may be represented by reconstruction formula plus source-bound sparse interval hash; no coordinate array is required.
canonicalContracts.nullRule: Missing canonical sets remain explicit null+HOLD records; unknown is not an empty set.

formula.domain: inclusive X/Z footprint defined by center and four directional extents; outside columns remain immutable-current
formula.dominantRatio: max(abs(x-centerX)/directionalXExtent, abs(z-centerZ)/directionalZExtent), compared by exact cross multiplication
formula.directAddedSolidIntervals: max(currentSurfaceY+1,72)..designSurfaceY minus exact relic, B08 interaction, and candidate B09 planning-reservation cells
formula.supportGapRule: any candidate support below Y=72 is counted and held; it is not silently filled outside the coordination envelope
formula.currentStateRule: all immutable current cells remain unchanged except that exact route cells may be future-passable planning reservations; no canonical block state is assigned here
